name: Custom Login Design
author: Hamid Ezzaki

sections.description:
Features:
* Upload a custom login logo
* Change login page and form background colors
* Customize input field styles (rounded or square)
* Modify heading, label, and link colors
* WordPress settings page with color picker support

Usage

  1. Navigate to Login Design in the WordPress admin panel
  2. Upload a logo and adjust colors using the settings page
  3. Save changes and visit your login page to see the customization

Contributing

  • Fork the repository
  • Create a feature branch
  • Make your changes
  • Open a pull request with a clear description of your changes

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL2 License.

Author

Hamid Ezzaki
Website: https://siteweb.es
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin files
  2. Upload the custom-login-design folder to your wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Go to the WordPress admin panel
  4. Activate the “Custom Login Design” plugin from the Plugins menu
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with full login customization features
